import pandas as pd

# Convert 'acts' to numeric, removing non-numeric characters

df['acts'] = pd.to_numeric(df['acts'], errors='coerce')

# Convert 'stages' to numeric, removing non-numeric characters
df['stages'] = df['stages'].str.replace(r'[^0-9]', '', regex=True)
df['stages'] = pd.to_numeric(df['stages'], errors='coerce')

# Calculate z-scores for 'acts' and 'stages'
df['acts_z'] = (df['acts'] - df['acts'].mean()) / df['acts'].std()
df['stages_z'] = (df['stages'] - df['stages'].mean()) / df['stages'].std()

# Identify any rows with z-scores > 2 or < -2 (common threshold for outliers)
outliers_acts = df[np.abs(df['acts_z']) > 2]
outliers_stages = df[np.abs(df['stages_z']) > 2]

# Determine if any outliers exist
final_answer_value = 'Yes' if not outliers_acts.empty or not outliers_stages.empty else 'No'
